concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/xdl-lite/requirements.md XDL1-SR-002 (successor, resolves XDL1-RVW-002), realized by XDL1-ARCH-03, XDL1-ARCH-06 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen as XDL1-DD-14 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/detailed-design.md sections 5 and 7.
responsibilities: Compile declared System/Node/Component/ComponentInstance/Interface/Endpoint/Flow/Network intent into the plan using only existing v1alpha1 semantic entities.
Introduce no new top-level resource kind, no new attribute in the core schemas, and no competing configuration language.
Reference every declared flow concept to an existing semantic entity in the emitted plan.

Project every declared core parameter deterministically: Component.spec.parameters[] into that component's components[scope="component-instance"].declaredParameters, and System.spec.parameters[] into exactly one components[scope="system"].declaredParameters entry emitted first (no duplication, no drop).
Project declared Component.spec.models[] and System.spec.models[] into the matching components[].modelRefs[] as references only.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
title: XDL1-SR-002-CMP allocation - Logical system/component/flow intent mapped to existing kinds
